summary: Thin stdcall proxy: first calls the gate sub_50FEA7 with constant argument 1, then forwards no arguments through the function pointer read from global off_5D7864 and returns its result. The gate is invoked before the indirect dispatch.

operations.description: Call sub_50FEA7 with constant 1 before dispatching; the gate runs before the indirect call.
Load the target function pointer from global off_5D7864 and call it with no arguments.
Return the integer result produced by the indirect callee.

unresolved: Purpose of the gate sub_50FEA7(1u) and why it is called before dispatch.
Runtime target of off_5D7864 is a mutable function pointer; the actual callee is unknown statically.
Owner of the object the proxy dispatches into is unknown.
